purpose: Audit exactly one deployment-observable sensor-consistency mechanism after v54-v56 without treating different ocean depths as redundant instruments or reusing closed cross-layer residuals.

single_mechanism.name: causal colocated redundant-thermistor parity residual
single_mechanism.scientific_fingerprint: Within each station-layer-time, compare simultaneous independently identified colocated temperature channels and use their parity residual as a sensor-failure observable on anchor-negative rows.

primary_source.title: Analytical Redundancy and the Design of Robust Failure Detection Systems
primary_source.authors: Edward Y. Chow and Alan S. Willsky
primary_source.claim_boundary: The paper establishes residual generation from authenticated redundancy relations as a fault-detection method. It does not establish that P1 layers are redundant sensors, that P1 exposes multiple colocated channels, or that a parity residual improves P1 performance.

required_but_absent: two or more independent colocated temperature channels per station-layer-time

layer_identity_warning.finding: Layer ordinals are not stable sensor identities across years; depth deployment changes are handled as regimes.

schema_support_audit.reason: The allowed schema has one temperature value per row and no independently identified colocated channel. Different layers observe different physical depths and cannot supply an authenticated sensor-parity equation.

base_cross_layer_features.overlap: Existing features already compute simultaneous same-station peer means, residuals, peer counts, and station-layer temperature spread.

stratification_peer_family.overlap: Existing label-blind peer features already use simultaneous cross-layer change coherence and gated peer residuals.

long_event_cross_layer_family.overlap: The long-event family already computes same-station/same-time other-layer residuals for temp, psal, and depth. Relabeling those physically distinct depths as redundant probes creates no new measurement.

physical_profile_closures.overlap: Physical consistency and vertical-profile/rank transforms are closed and cannot authenticate different-depth layers as redundant instruments.

decision.reason: A true redundant-channel residual would be deployment-observable and scientifically distinct, but the allowed P1 schema contains neither redundant channel identity nor measurements. Using other layers would violate the parity premise and duplicate existing peer residuals.
decision.minimum_new_evidence: Competition-allowed synchronized readings from at least two independently identified colocated temperature probes per station-layer, with stable instrument IDs and calibration/uncertainty provenance across train and deployment.
